title: Java Script / j Query DOM Selectors
text:
JavaScript / jQuery DOM Selectors jQuery vs JavaScript jQuery was created in 2006 by John Resig. It was designed to handle Browser Incompatibilities and to simplify HTML DOM Manipulation, Event Handling, Animations, and Ajax. For more than 10 years, jQuery has been the most popular JavaScript library in the world. However, after JavaScript Version 5 (2009), most of the jQuery utilities can be solved with a few lines of standard JavaScript: Finding HTML Element by Id Return the element with id="id01": Finding HTML Elements by Tag Name Return all

elements: Finding HTML Elements by Class Name Return all elements with class="intro". Finding HTML Elements by CSS Selectors Return a list of all

elements with class="intro".
